meta.title: Hotel Pre-Opening Consulting | HotelMinds
meta.description: Commercial pre-opening consulting for hotels: pricing, revenue management, PMS, booking channels, direct sales and technology setup before launch.

hero.headline: Launch with the Right Commercial Setup from Day One.
hero.subheader: HotelMinds helps new hotel openings, major renovations and re-openings build revenue management, pricing, booking channels, direct sales and commercial technology before entering the market.
hero.btnOutro: We combine strategic planning with hands-on setup and implementation.

services.headline: Strong openings are built long before opening day.

bullets.text: Commercial problems often start early — when pricing, systems, distribution and responsibilities are decided too late or without a clear plan.
Key pricing and sales decisions are made under time pressure.
Systems are selected without considering how they need to work together.
Booking channels are opened only shortly before launch, leaving little time to build demand.
Rates, room types and restrictions are set without a clear market logic.
Too many parties are involved, but no one clearly owns the full commercial setup.

subServices.headline: The commercial foundations that need to be in place before launch.
subServices.intro: Build the Commercial Strategy Early: Define positioning, target segments, pricing logic and sales priorities before key decisions become rushed or expensive to change.

bullets.header: Put the Right Technology in Place
bullets.text: Select and implement the PMS, Channel Manager, Booking Engine, Revenue Management tools and payment setup required for an efficient launch.
Set up room and rate structures, Booking.com, Expedia, direct booking channels, policies and availability early enough to start building demand before opening.
Establish reporting, workflows and clear commercial responsibilities so the hotel can open with structure rather than react after launch.

bullets.title: Strategy & Setup
bullets.text: We define the sales strategy, pricing logic, systems and responsibilities required before opening.

bullets.title: Build & Connect
bullets.text: We set up the PMS, Channel Manager, Booking Engine, room and rate structures, booking channels and direct sales.

bullets.title: Launch & Support
bullets.text: We make sure the setup is ready before opening, support the go-live and adjust where needed once real demand starts coming in.

finalCta.headline: Open with the Right Commercial Setup from Day One.
finalCta.text: Let’s make sure pricing, systems, booking channels and direct sales are ready before opening.
